children: BNB price has climbed roughly 44% from the July 1 low of $538 to $769 by September 19. Now, BNB is approaching the $794 resistance, with the next major question being whether continued Binance activity can keep the rally moving.
BNB Price Rally Runs Into $794 Resistance
The move has been substantial. BNB climbed from $538 to $769, while rising interest in Binance has been cited as a major source of demand.
As Bitcoin and Altcoins continue trading on Binance, increased exchange usage has boosted activity across the platform. That activity is supporting demand for BNB, according to the supplied data.

If that usage continues, the current setup points toward further strength. A sustained break above $794 could allow BNB to continue its rally toward $1,000 by the end of 2026. That’s the bullish scenario. But $794 isn’t just another number on the chart.
Binance Activity Adds Fuel Behind BNB

The broader Binance ecosystem is also seeing activity through tokenized stocks. Crypto Rank recently highlighted that the tokenized stocks market has reached $3.5 billion in total market capitalization.

BNB Chain leads that market with $1 billion, followed by Ethereum at $754 million and Solana at $679 million. Arbitrum holds $317 million, while Avalanche has $230 million, X Layer $159 million and Robinhood Chain $156 million.
The top three chains together account for around 70% of the total tokenized stocks market capitalization, with BNB Chain holding the largest share among them.
Tokenized Stocks Give BNB Chain More Activity

The $1 billion tokenized stocks market capitalization on BNB Chain adds another data point to the network’s current activity. It also puts BNB Chain ahead of Ethereum and Solana in the supplied distribution. Still, the price doesn’t move in a straight line.
If BNB fails to $794, the rally could lose momentum and send BNB price back toward $675. A deeper retracement could eventually bring the token back toward the $538 support.

For BNB price, $794 is therefore the immediate technical checkpoint, while continued Binance activity and BNB Chain’s tokenized stocks position provide the fundamental backdrop for a possible move toward $1,000.

title: BNB Price Near $794 as Tokenized Stocks Hit $3.5B
